name: Jacunda Rangers: The Battle for Paracuru
storyline: The story centers on two warring nations. Following a false claim of an attack, Paracuru declares war to seize territory. In response, Corrupião, Jacundá’s finest pilot, is deployed to the front lines. Meanwhile, his old rival Malta hears the news and joins the fray for Paracuru not just for his country, but for a long-awaited rematch against Corrupião! Little did they know, a much larger conspiracy was unfolding behind the scenes. Now, it is up to them to uncover the truth and discover why this conflict began!
summary: Jacundá Rangers - The Battle for Paracuru is a mecha-themed shoot-'em-up that stands out with its PvP, arena, and survival battle modes. Choose your character, power up your mecha, and prepare for an epic battle for control of Paracuru!
